subject: general
question: The situation in an economy when inflation and unemployment both are at higher levels is known as ______ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**stagflation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• An economy that is suffering both rising inflation and stagnant economic output is said to be in** stagflation.**
 
• **Stagflation **was initially identified in the 1970s when an oil shock caused high unemployment and rapid inflation in many industrialised nations.
